headlines.title: A $1,500,000 Portfolio in HP, Truist and PepsiCo Pays $65,144 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $1,500,000 portfolio split evenly across HP, Truist Financial and PepsiCo pays about $65,100 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $5,430 a month. HP’s dividend looks the safest of the three, taking 28% of free cash flow over the trailing twelve months.

headlines.title: Seed-oil-free foods are now a $1 billion business. Stanford scientists say the health claims don’t hold up
headlines.summary: Sales of seed-oil-free foods are surging, helped by a certification seal and a shift in federal diet advice. Scientists at Stanford and Tufts say the case against the oils is thin.

headlines.title: Hyatt and PepsiCo Enter New Chapter with a 10-Year Collaboration Supporting Guest Experience and Growth Across 700+ Properties in the United States
headlines.summary: Hyatt and PepsiCo (NASDAQ: PEP) announce a 10-year agreement renewing their longstanding food and beverage relationship across America. The agreement covers more than 700 Hyatt properties in the United States across Hyatt's Classics and Essentials brand portfolios and reflects a shared commitment to supporting Hyatt's continued growth while creating relevant, enjoyable experiences for guests throughout their stay.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
